items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Oh, I started playing with this, this combination with my dad and them, you know.

ctx.x: Who did you play your first job with?

Oh, I started playing with this, this combination with my dad and them, you know. And then we started playing over in the city, you see. Playing around, around the story of the early head, dance halls, you remember that. And we used to use, one time they cut out the brass, you see.
